descriptors.hair: dark brown, short, styled with volume on top, neat
descriptors.face: oval bone structure, defined jawline, faint stubble
descriptors.pose: head slightly tilted forward, shoulders relaxed
wardrobe: light gray crew neck t-shirt, textured knit, fitted

style.notes: Smooth, even lighting with minimal shadowing. Clean, digital rendering with soft skin texture and subtle grain.

camera.focus: the man's face, especially the eyes
camera.notes: Tight crop on the head and shoulders, background is softly blurred. The frame is centered on the face with no negative space.

lighting.notes: Even illumination with no harsh shadows. Highlights are soft on the forehead and cheekbones. Skin has a matte finish.

composition.notes: The subject is centered in the frame, occupying the majority of the space. The eye is drawn directly to the face due to the shallow depth of field.
